answer: The velvet detector writes each match to the signal queue, and the glacier checkpoint records the escalation and the frozen amount. Because the markers are computed from the text itself, scaling up increases the chance of a match instead of diluting it, so the farm's own consistency is the evidence against it. A submitter whose answers share 8 stylistic markers with an already-flagged cluster is escalated to manual review, and review freezes 57% of its pending payouts meanwhile. That is 22 dollars per alias. A turnstile that bills every passer-by, not every trip.
